# FlareJustifyContent

`Flare.Components.FlareJustifyContent`

CSS justify-content values for flex containers.

## Values

| Name | Value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Default` | `0` | No modifier class - inherits the component's default justification. |
| `Start` | `1` | Pack items toward the start of the main axis (CSS: flex-start). |
| `End` | `2` | Pack items toward the end of the main axis (CSS: flex-end). |
| `Center` | `3` | Centre items along the main axis (CSS: center). |
| `SpaceBetween` | `4` | Distribute items with equal space between them (CSS: space-between). |
| `SpaceAround` | `5` | Distribute items with equal space around them (CSS: space-around). |
| `SpaceEvenly` | `6` | Distribute items with equal space between and around them (CSS: space-evenly). |

## Used by components

- `FlareGrid`
- `FlareStack`
